description: Ministry of Higher Education and Highways - Order made to amend the Schedule to the Order Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 916/7 of 27.03.1996 establishing the South Eastem Univirsity of Sri Lanka by the addition 'Department of Economics and Statistics' under the Heading Department of Study
reasoning: The gazette content contains an order made under Section 27(1) of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978, which amends a previous order to add a new Department of Economics and Statistics to the South Eastern University of Sri Lanka. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and modifications to existing legal frameworks, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While a minister is named, this is incidental to the primary legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on amending the university's structure through statutory authority rather than detailing the minister's portfolio responsibilities.
